ANNA Hungariæ Regis filia, prædicti Ferdinandi vxor,
speciosa quidem, proba & viro gratissima fuit: ex quo etiam li-

page.notes: Two medallion portraits are illustrations, not text; only their printed legends are transcribed. The right medallion's lower legend is too worn to read and is left out. "Carionislib." is printed without a space; written here as "Carionis lib." with the spacing corrected. "Vaiuodæ", "Monachũ", and similar forms are kept as printed.
